title: The Ramparts of Ice Season 2 Anime Previews Opening Theme in 2nd Promo Video
content: The official website for the television anime of Kōcha Agasawa 's The Ramparts of Ice ( Koori no Jyōheki or Ice Castle Wall ) manga began streaming a second promotional video on Monday for the anime's second season .
author: ANN

title: Motohiro Den's Funsō Deshitara Hatta made Geopolitical Manga Gets TV Anime
content: The official website of Kodansha 's Morning magazine announced on Monday that Motohiro Den 's Funsō Deshitara Hatta made (If It's a Conflict, Leave it to Hatta) manga will get a television anime adaptation. More details will be revealed at a later date.
author: ANN

title: New Sgt. Frog TV Anime's 2nd Main Trailer Reveals Theme Songs, 5 New Cast
content: The staff for Keroro Gunsō ☆ , an all-new Sgt. Frog television anime , started streaming the anime's second main trailer, and revealed five new cast members on Monday. author: ANN

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Special New Animation by KONAMI Released for Kazuki Takahashi Art Exhibition
content: A new Yu-Gi-Oh! special animation has been released to commemorate KAZUKI TAKAHASHI: YU-GI-OH! ART WORKS , the first original art exhibition dedicated to series creator Kazuki Takahashi.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Ramparts of Ice Season 2 New Trailer Previews Opening Theme by THE BEAT GARDEN
content: The Ramparts of Ice Season 2 has released its second trailer, previewing the opening theme “Escort” by THE BEAT GARDEN ahead of the anime’s October 1, 2026 premiere. The anime will stream weekly exclusively on Netflix.
author: Anime Corner

title: Ave Mujica prima aurora Movie Releases Official Trailer
content: The official trailer for the upcoming Ave Mujica prima aurora movie has been released on Monday. It features a new song from the band titled “A Song of Romance.” The movie is set to premiere on October 16 and the latest song is also now available to stream. Check out more Ave Mujica: BanG Dream!
author: Anime Corner

title: Ranma 1/2 Season 3 Reveals Third Trailer, Opening and Ending Theme Songs
content: Ranma 1/2 Season 3 revealed its third trailer, previewing the new opening and ending theme songs ahead of the anime’s return on October 3, 2026. Studio MAPPA is back to handle the animation, with Konosuke Uda returning to direct alongside most of the core staff.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Hello, I Am a Witch and My Crush Wants Me to Make a Love Potion!' Anime's Video Reveals More Cast, Staff, Theme Songs, October 5 Debut
content: Kadokawa unveiled a new promotional video and visual for the television anime of writer Eiko Mutsuhana and illustrator Vient 's Hello, I Am a Witch and My Crush Wants Me to Make a Love Potion! ( Dōmo, Sukina Hito ni Horegusuri o Irai Sareta Majo Desu. ) light novel series on Monday.
author: ANN

title: Fate/Extra Record Game Reveals Character Video for Caster
content: Aniplex revealed a new character promotional video for Type-Moon studio BB's Fate/Extra Record game, the remake of Marvelous Entertainment 's Fate/Extra PlayStation Portable game, on Monday. The video features the character Caster, voiced by Chiwa Saitō .
author: ANN

title: Even a Replica Can Fall in Love Manga Ends with 7th Volume
content: Kadokawa is listing the seventh compiled book volume of Momose Hanada 's manga adaptation of Harunadon 's Even a Replica Can Fall in Love ( Replica Datte, Koi o Suru ) novel series as its final volume. Kadokawa will ship the final volume on October 27.
author: ANN
